reason: A DeepSeek Harness plugin that heuristically triages and compacts stale, duplicate, failed, oversized, and low-value session context to reduce context growth and token usage.

summaries.zh: 用于 DeepSeek Harness 的会话上下文整理插件，可按启发式规则压缩过时、重复、失败、过大和低价值的上下文内容。
summaries.en: A DeepSeek Harness plugin that uses heuristic rules to compact stale, repeated, failed, oversized, and low-value session context.

capabilities: Analyzes session history using heuristic rules
Rewrites or removes selected stale, repeated, failed, oversized, and low-value context blocks
Provides automatic, manual, and forced context compaction through the host harness
Exposes a model-visible triage tool and a human CLI command
Writes compression transactions and audit reports to the session log
